gaps.reason: SME offer documents are filed with BSE SME / NSE Emerge, not SEBI; both sources unreachable

gaps.scope: India addenda / corrigenda to offer documents
gaps.reason: Deliberately skipped; only the DRHP, RHP and final offer document entries are kept. SEBI 'Public Issues' also lists the occasional FPO, which the list does not label separately

gaps.reason: kind.krx.co.kr, www.krx.co.kr, global.krx.co.kr and open.krx.co.kr answer Akamai 'Access Denied'; data.krx.co.kr requires a login; OpenDART needs an API key (none available)

gaps.scope: Japan new listings 2010-01 to 2015-12 (except 2015-08)
gaps.reason: JPX new-listing archive pages only reach back to 2022 and the monthly statistics archive to 2016; older monthly PDFs have unguessable URLs (only the Aug 2015 PDF was found via search)

gaps.scope: Japan technical listings
gaps.reason: The JPX 'New Listings' table includes holding-company formations and other technical listings alongside IPOs without a flag; rows are titled 'New listing' and not filtered

gaps.reason: EDINET not probed/collected in this pass

gaps.scope: Australia companies delisted since listing (2010-2021 floats no longer on ASX)
gaps.reason: Only the current ASX listed-companies directory carries listing dates; ASX has no reachable historical new-listings archive, so delisted/merged floats are missing (survivorship)

gaps.scope: Australia prospectuses
gaps.reason: ASX announcements search is disallowed by robots.txt (/search*) and no other prospectus archive is reachable

gaps.scope: UK prospectuses (FCA National Storage Mechanism) and RNS intention-to-float notices

gaps.scope: UK symbols
gaps.reason: LSE issuer archives carry no TIDM; TIDM is taken from today's LSE instrument list where the issuer name matches, else a name-derived symbol is used

gaps.scope: UK companies listed and delisted within the same month
gaps.reason: LSE archives are month-end snapshots, so such admissions are invisible

gaps.scope: India symbols
gaps.reason: SEBI filings carry no ticker; symbol is the upper-case company name slug

gaps.scope: South Korea company names
gaps.reason: DART lists the filer under its current name; renamed companies show today's name, not the name at filing

gaps.scope: index membership (all markets)
gaps.reason: Not set: new listings are not index members on the listing date in these sources; no membership was inferred

gaps.scope: UK issuers first listed in the archive long after their admission date
gaps.reason: 426 admissions dropped: the issuer only appears in a monthly snapshot more than two months after its stated admission date (renamed issuers whose earlier name already carries the admission, or archive scope changes such as debt vehicles added later); the date cannot be confirmed as a new equity listing

gaps.scope: UK preference-share / debenture issuers
gaps.reason: 108 issuers classed in LSE sectors 'Preference' or 'Debentures & Loans' excluded as non-equity listings

gaps.scope: UK admissions that were moves between markets
gaps.reason: 309 admissions dropped because the issuer already appeared in an earlier monthly LSE snapshot (AIM<->Main Market moves, re-admissions)

gaps.scope: South Korea equity registration statements by filers now unlisted (non-SPAC)
gaps.reason: 560 filings excluded: filer is not KOSPI/KOSDAQ listed today (withdrawn IPOs, since-delisted IPOs, foreign employee-share offerings and unlisted public offerings cannot be told apart without opening documents, and DART robots.txt disallows the document viewer)

gaps.scope: South Korea follow-on offerings
